prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic, except for winning home wait_info tests where predictions were too low.
Adding a new screen at the adoption stage (2 tests) or finish stage (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and was stopped early.
Home wait_info changes (9 tests) were helpful in three significant wins, though no effect was seen in the remaining six tests.
Reordering sign-in steps (2 tests), adding sign-in hints (2 tests), modifying finish layouts (2 tests), changing finish copy (2 tests), and home redesigns (2 tests) consistently showed no effect.
Evidence for most other specific kinds of change remains thin because fewer than two tests agree.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Arrival Activity & Time Stream: Display an active time estimate counter alongside desktop rendering activity updates on the waiting screen while the pet is being prepared. (why: The home stage has a high mean waiting time of 2336s, and previous home wait_info tests provided the strongest conversion wins.)
1: [home, notification] Desktop Arrival Readiness Notification Prompt: Add an instant background notification opt-in prompt with a completion badge on the pet generation waiting screen. (why: Home wait time is very high (2336s mean), making notification opt-in crucial so users do not miss when their pet completes rendering.)
2: [choose_path, layout] Story Carousel Journey Overview: Switch the story screen layout to a dynamic carousel showcasing desktop pet interaction features. (why: Setting clear expectations early reduces overall onboarding drop-off and prepares users for subsequent adoption steps.)
3: [adoption, copy] Account Persistence & Pet Storage Clarity Copy: Update adoption certificate copy to explicitly assure users their pet companion is permanently linked to their signed-in account. (why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing back in, indicating confusion around account pet persistence during adoption.)
4: [choose_path, new_screen] Pre-Onboarding Experience Intro Screen: Insert a new introductory welcome screen 'new_desktop_companion_welcome' before the story screen to introduce app capabilities. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 24.9%; an engaging front-door screen builds immediate value and sets expectations before commitment.)
5: [home, wait_info] Interactive Generation Care Tip Stream: Add an automated pet care tip carousel that rotates every 10 seconds during the home stage pet rendering wait. (why: Keeping users engaged with actionable tips during the long home stage wait time (median 201s) improves wait tolerance and win rates.)
